notes: Address confirmed: the Uber Eats store page prints 2500 St Charles Rd, Bellwood, IL 60104. No own website or first-party ordering page was found for this location (other Shark's sites belong to different franchise locations and were not used). PRICES ARE UBER EATS MARKETPLACE PRICES and are usually higher than in-store; treat them as such or omit them on the card. PARTIAL: the page lists 16 sections but only the first four returned items through the fetch tool (read twice, same result); Fish Combos, Chicken Dinners, Chicken Combo Dinners, Chicken Combos, Chicken Wings, Party Wings (1/2), Side Orders, Kids Meals, Drinks, Desserts and Family Pack came back as headings only, so no chicken/wings section could be verified beyond the two featured items. The page was read through a summarising fetch tool rather than raw HTML (a direct download returned 404), so item names and prices were cross-checked across two separate reads and matched, but were not verified character-by-character. 'Featured items' is Uber Eats' own grouping (first three are tagged #1–#3 most liked) and repeats items from Fish Dinners. Two more Shrimp Dinners entries were omitted because no size is given to explain the price: 'Jumbo Shrimp' $48.99 and 'Shrimp' $44.99. Descriptions on Uber Eats are generic one-liners (e.g. 'perfect for sharing with family'), so most were left blank. Page showed 'Delivery unavailable' when checked.
sourceDetail: Shark's Fish & Chicken (St Charles Rd) on Uber Eats
